name: Pietro
bio: Italian whom Wilde met at Nice in January 1899, on a three-day trip from La Napoule with Harold Mellor. Wilde described him to Robert Ross as 'a little Italian, Pietro, like a young St John', adding 'One would have followed him into the desert'. No surname, age, occupation, dates or further trace appear in the letter, and nothing else about him was found in the pages read.
bio_note: Sole source: Wilde to Robert Ross, Thursday [? 12 January 1899], Napoule, Complete Letters (2000), p. 1118. Dates: none recorded. Frankel treats the Nice trip at printed p. 245, naming Pietro as 'like a young St John' and adding nothing beyond the letter. No birth or death date is recorded, and none is likely to be found: the record preserves a first name (or a trade) in another man's correspondence and no surname to search by. Pietro Branca d'Oro is a different man: Palermo and Rome, April 1900, printed 1181, introduced by Wilde as a new addition to his circle. This Pietro is Nice, January 1899, printed 1118.
